passages.text: Now Solomon son of David established himself securely over his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him and highly exalted him.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the son of David.
Solomon became strong as king over his kingdom.
The LORD was Solomon’s God.
The LORD was with Solomon.
The LORD made Solomon very great.
passages.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֛ק שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בֶן־ דָּוִ֖יד עַל־ מַלְכוּת֑וֹ וַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַֽיְגַדְּלֵ֖הוּ לְמָֽעְלָה׃

passages.text: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every leader in all Israel—the heads of the families.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the son of David.
Solomon was king over Israel.
Solomon spoke to all Israel.
He spoke to the commanders of thousands.
He spoke to the commanders of hundreds.
He spoke to the judges.
He spoke to every leader in Israel.
He spoke to the heads of the families.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל לְשָׂרֵי֩ הָאֲלָפִ֨ים וְהַמֵּא֜וֹת וְלַשֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים וּלְכֹ֛ל נָשִׂ֥יא לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָבֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon because it was the location of God’s Tent of Meeting, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the son of David.
Solomon was king over Israel.
The whole assembly of Israel was with Solomon.
Solomon and all the people went together.
They went to the high place at Gibeon.
Gibeon was important.
God’s Tent of Meeting was at Gibeon.
Moses made the Tent of Meeting.
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
Moses made the Tent of Meeting in the wilderness.
passages.original: וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ וְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ לַבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּגִבְע֑וֹן כִּי־ שָׁ֣ם הָיָ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: Now David had brought the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David brought the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
David prepared a place for the ark.
David set up a tent for the ark in Jerusalem.
David placed the ark in the tent he had pitched in Jerusalem.
passages.original: אֲבָ֗ל אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ הֶעֱלָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ מִקִּרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים בַּֽהֵכִ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑יד כִּ֧י נָֽטָה־ ל֛וֹ אֹ֖הֶל בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: But the bronze altar made by Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, was in Gibeon before the tabernacle of the LORD. So Solomon and the assembly inquired of Him there.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel was the son of Uri and the grandson of Hur.
Bezalel made a bronze altar.
The bronze altar stood in Gibeon.
The altar was in front of the tabernacle of the LORD.
Solomon was the king of Israel.
The assembly was with Solomon.
Solomon and the assembly went to the bronze altar.
They inquired of the LORD there.
passages.original: וּמִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ בְּצַלְאֵל֙ בֶּן־ אוּרִ֣י בֶן־ ח֔וּר שָׂ֕ם לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּדְרְשֵׁ֥הוּ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וְהַקָּהָֽל׃

passages.text: Solomon offered sacrifices there before the LORD on the bronze altar in the Tent of Meeting, where he offered a thousand burnt offerings.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
\r\nHe went to the bronze altar.
\r\nThe bronze altar stood before the LORD.
\r\nThe bronze altar was in the Tent of Meeting.
\r\nSolomon offered sacrifices there.
\r\nHe offered a thousand burnt offerings on the altar.
passages.original: וַיַּעַל֩ שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה שָׁ֜ם עַל־ מִזְבַּ֤ח הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛יו עֹל֖וֹת אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: That night God appeared to Solomon and said, “Ask, and I will give it to you!”
passages.sermon: God appeared to Solomon at night.\r\nGod spoke to Solomon.\r\nGod said, “Ask what you want me to give you.”
passages.original: בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא נִרְאָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ שְׁאַ֖ל מָ֥ה אֶתֶּן־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Solomon replied to God: “You have shown much loving devotion to my father David, and You have made me king in his place.
passages.sermon:
Solomon spoke to God.
Solomon said, “You showed great kindness to my father David.
You made me king after him.
”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים אַתָּ֗ה עָשִׂ֛יתָ עִם־ דָּוִ֥יד אָבִ֖י חֶ֣סֶד גָּד֑וֹל וְהִמְלַכְתַּ֖נִי תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: Now, O LORD God, let Your promise to my father David be fulfilled. For You have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
God made Solomon king after his father David.
Solomon spoke to the LORD God.
He said, “O LORD God, let Your promise to my father David come true.
You have made me king over many people.
Your people are as numerous as the dust of the earth.”
passages.original: עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔ עִ֖ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַכְתַּ֔נִי עַל־ עַ֕ם רַ֖ב כַּעֲפַ֥ר הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Now grant me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may lead this people. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?”
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
He spoke to God.
He said, “God, give me wisdom.
Give me knowledge.
I need these gifts to lead Your people.
I must guide them and make decisions for them.
Your people are very many.
No one can govern such a great people without Your help.”
passages.original: עַתָּ֗ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּמַדָּע֙ תֶּן־ לִ֔י וְאֵֽצְאָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה וְאָב֑וֹאָה כִּֽי־ מִ֣י יִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת־ עַמְּךָ֥ הַזֶּ֖ה הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ס

passages.text: God said to Solomon, “Since this was in your heart instead of requesting riches or wealth or glory for yourself or death for your enemies—and since you have not even requested long life but have asked for wisdom and knowledge to govern My people over whom I have made you king— therefore wisdom and knowledge have been granted to you. And I will also give you riches and wealth and honor unlike anything given to the kings before you or after you.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Solomon.
God saw what was in Solomon’s heart.
Solomon did not ask for riches.
Solomon did not ask for wealth.
Solomon did not ask for glory.
Solomon did not ask for the death of his enemies.
Solomon did not ask for a long life.
Solomon asked for wisdom.
Solomon asked for knowledge.
Solomon wanted to govern God’s people.
God made Solomon king over these people.
God said, “I give you wisdom.
I give you knowledge.
I will also give you riches.
I will give you wealth.
I will give you honor.
No king before you had these things like you will.
No king after you will have these things like you will.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים׀ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֡ה יַ֣עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה זֹ֜את עִם־ לְבָבֶ֗ךָ וְלֹֽא־ שָׁ֠אַלְתָּ עֹ֣שֶׁר נְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ וְאֵת֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאֶ֔יךָ וְגַם־ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לֹ֣א שָׁאָ֑לְתָּ וַתִּֽשְׁאַל־ לְךָ֙ חָכְמָ֣ה וּמַדָּ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁפּוֹט֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלַכְתִּ֖יךָ עָלָֽיו׃ הַֽחָכְמָ֥ה וְהַמַּדָּ֖ע נָת֣וּן לָ֑ךְ וְעֹ֨שֶׁר וּנְכָסִ֤ים וְכָבוֹד֙ אֶתֶּן־ לָ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ לֹא־ הָ֣יָה כֵ֗ן לַמְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַחֲרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־ כֵּֽן׃

passages.text: So Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place in Gibeon before the Tent of Meeting, and he reigned over Israel.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He went to Jerusalem.
He came from the high place in Gibeon.
He had been at the Tent of Meeting in Gibeon.
He began to reign over Israel.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה לַבָּמָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ בְּגִבְעוֹן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִלִּפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: Solomon accumulated 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king over Israel.
Solomon gathered many chariots and horses.
He collected 1,400 chariots.
He collected 12,000 horses.
Solomon placed some chariots and horses in the chariot cities.
He kept some chariots and horses with him in Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֣ף שְׁלֹמֹה֮ רֶ֣כֶב וּפָרָשִׁים֒ וַֽיְהִי־ ל֗וֹ אֶ֤לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּשְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּנִּיחֵם֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְעִם־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as abundant as sycamore in the foothills.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon ruled in Jerusalem.
He made silver very common in the city.
He made gold very common in the city.
Silver and gold became as plentiful as stones.
He brought in many cedar trees.
Cedar became as abundant as sycamore trees in the foothills.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֧סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָ֛ב בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת הָאֲרָזִ֗ים נָתַ֛ן כַּשִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה לָרֹֽב׃

passages.text: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and Kue; the royal merchants purchased them from Kue.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon owned many horses.
Solomon’s horses came from Egypt and Kue.
The king’s merchants bought the horses from Kue.
The merchants paid a price for the horses.
passages.original: וּמוֹצָ֧א הַסּוּסִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וּמִקְוֵ֕א סֹחֲרֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ מִקְוֵ֥א יִקְח֖וּ בִּמְחִֽיר׃

passages.text: A chariot could be imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. Likewise, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king in Jerusalem.
Solomon imported chariots from Egypt.
Each chariot cost six hundred shekels of silver.
Solomon also imported horses from Egypt.
Each horse cost one hundred and fifty shekels of silver.
Solomon’s officials exported chariots and horses.
They sold them to all the kings of the Hittites.
They also sold them to the kings of Aram.
passages.original: וַֽ֠יַּעֲלוּ וַיּוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִמִּצְרַ֤יִם מֶרְכָּבָה֙ בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְס֖וּס בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמֵאָ֑ה וְ֠כֵן לְכָל־ מַלְכֵ֧י הַֽחִתִּ֛ים וּמַלְכֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם בְּיָדָ֥ם יוֹצִֽיאוּ׃
